analysis:
Examined base_text units of docs/reference/configuration.md lines 1-484. In the visible region, the only changed line is the 'Last updated' date at line 3, which changes from 2026-10-30 to 2026-10-31. The remaining sections are unchanged base text: GLM local qualification, prefix cache default (lines 62-67, T-041), add-on hold (TB-012), sandbox CLI (TB-013), endpoint resumption/logout (A-008, T-053), App Attest worker opt-ins (TB-011), model cache and engine variables. These contain no regressions.

The substantive changes are at head lines 923-1015 (base 923-1041) in the 'Cluster runtime facts' section. They are not supplied as units in this batch. The patch excerpt states that signed releases now register cluster_runtime in the POST /v1/releases payload (A-005, A-011, A-017). It also states that a coordinator accepting the block derives cluster approvals, pair-serving grants and parity qualifications from it. Before this change, approvals were only operator-copied into the approval file.

This could merge release publication with qualification or approval authority. T-054 and A-017 note that release publication is not qualification. Integration should verify that the head text at lines 923-1015 and lines 1077-1104 states the following:
- Release-derived cluster approvals require independent qualification.
- Each member still recomputes digests locally.
- Leaked release keys cannot grant pair serving.

Backend behavior is platform-owned and outside the supplied evidence. Changes at head lines 1631-1636 are also unreviewed here.
